tickets.title: Prove the Drydock QuarterDeck information architecture
ac: QuarterDeck starts from the Drydock repository with one command
The console shows honest current state and a simple delivery plan
The product owner can answer questions and record review decisions
The Ship's Log concept and implementation gap are visible
tickets.body: Use this first cut to determine which information and controls belong in the permanent Drydock QuarterDeck.

tickets.title: Implement the plan workflow
ac: `drydock plan init` creates or updates `BUILD_PLAN_INTENT.md`
`drydock plan create` generates and merges `MANIFEST.md`
`drydock plan show` reports the current plan
Focused, CLI, integration, and regression tests pass
tickets.body: Next recommended vertical slice from the Drydock development contract.

tickets.title: Implement the single decision writer and Ship's Log
tickets.blocked_reason: Depends on a stable BUILD_PLAN contract and explicit decision transition rules.
ac: All plan state transitions pass through one decision writer
Governed agents and Drydock workflows append material events to `logs/ships_log.jsonl`
Entries are append-only and support `supersedes`
Decision behavior is covered by deterministic tests
tickets.body: Create the reusable mutation boundary required by CLI and QuarterDeck review.

tickets.title: Generate and reconcile QuarterDeck projections
tickets.blocked_reason: Requires implemented BUILD_PLAN parsing and the single decision writer.
ac: QuarterDeck config and tickets regenerate from authoritative project state
Evidence and review items are surfaced automatically
Approve, revise, reject, and reopen-failed reconcile through the decision writer
The generated QuarterDeck can be deleted and recreated without losing authoritative state
tickets.body: Replace authored first-cut artifacts with a generated, throwaway projection.

tickets.title: Implement build status, execution, evidence, and score
ac: Build status reports every block and runnable frontier
Build executes the frontier and writes reviewable evidence
Score measures delivery health across the specified dimensions
Existing accepted work remains stable during incremental rebuilds
tickets.body: Complete the execution side of the Blueprint-to-review loop after planning contracts stabilize.
